additional_info.subject: RE: AW: AW: ID0461465-DC/Si-D/DE-[Y2/S5313651774001] Charging issue CRM:03056000490
additional_info.body:
Good afternoon Mr. Jepsen,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0461465.
I am writing you to provide you feedback of the behavior of the chargers after the update to v8.0.5 in regards of error
"secc pilot is E"
.
After the update, the error was communicated to the Backend 6 times:
3 times for charger
Y2/S5 313651774001
on
2025-11-21T03:22:51, 2025-11-19T10:14:36,
2025-11-19T05:03:01
3 times for charger
Y2/S5 313661877001
on
2025-11-21T10:34:46, 2025-11-19T10:27:36,
2025-11-19T03:27:29
I analyzed all sessions, and in all cases, the message was communicated to the Backend at the end of charging sessions, when the pilot state went briefly to E in exit of the charging process, after receiving the stop from the EV and before disconnecting.
This is a normal behavior in the communication between charger and vehicle, and it is sometimes reported as statusnotification to the Backend.
From my analysis, is it clear that the "secc pilot is E" did not cause any random unavailability of the outlets, as it was doing before the updates.
Therefore, I would consider the issue solved, and I will proceed to close the ticket.
Please do not hesitate to contact us again and open a new ticket, in case a new issue is detected from your side.
Thank you and have a nice wekeend!
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
Siemens AG
